_comment: Stage 0 / S-4 — PUBLIC (unauthenticated) visual baseline. Hand-curated from `php artisan route:list` by selecting GET routes with no auth middleware that return 200 text/html, then excluding destructive, download, JSON and vendor-UI endpoints. Used by baseline.spec.js when E2E_USERNAME/E2E_PASSWORD are absent. The authenticated 494-page baseline lives in routes.json and still requires credentials.

_excluded./log-viewer, /log-viewer/logs: vendor log-viewer UI; publicly reachable (flagged separately) but not app UI worth baselining

_coverage: Covers layouts: fc.layouts.master (31 pages) and layouts.app (7 pages). Does NOT cover admin.layouts.master (494 pages) - that needs credentials.
